correctness.rationale: Every cyclic 01-count difference is n w_i-b and hence equals the step of a height walk. Coprime b makes its n heights a complete residue system; normalizing the unique minimum forces the sets {0..n−1} or {0,2..n−1,n+1} for spread n−1 and n+1, and rules out spread n. The lifted-residue runner-up has legal steps because b,a>=2; each class is unique up to rotations. The mean-height identity proves the exact integer spectra. Direct exhaustive enumeration of 33,122 words, 457,898 rotations in 44 parameter classes n=5..15 passed. Infinite quantifiers rely on proof, not finite tests.

value.rationale: Fixed-composition cyclic 2-binomial dispersion is a natural fingerprint statistic in combinatorics on words. The theorem gives a complete sharp minimum-plus-runner-up classification over infinitely many coprime interior compositions, with a forbidden intermediate spread and a unique non-Christoffel necklace whose spectrum has exactly two holes. This clarifies quantitative stability immediately beyond the familiar balanced Christoffel extremizer; it is neither an arbitrary finite slice nor a mere reformulation of the increment identity.
